note: Method fixture. The frozen set, reworded as if it were new. This run must fail.

items.title: AI chip factories are still dramatically under-built (updated)
items.story: Reprint. New tapes this week did not change the situation.
items.force: they did not build enough plants.

items.title: In July the market panicked. The factories did not.
items.force: the share price and the factory can point opposite ways.

items.title: Compute is getting dearer, and old cards still earn
items.force: more demand for the same scarce machines, and the machines last.

items.title: The money is going to the plants, not the next model
items.force: capital follows the scarce physical thing, not the research team.

items.title: Ordinary funding may be exhausted. That is why they are lending to themselves.
items.force: if ordinary money is exhausted, the stack starts lending to itself.

items.title: Power is the problem. Nobody agrees what happens next.
items.force: the problem is agreed. The path and the fix are not.

items.title: Mid-August prints on the same plant cards
items.story: New tapes this week, folded onto old cards. Not a new situation.
items.force: this week’s tape agrees with a card already there.
